title: iOS apps
description: For an iOS or iPadOS app: privacy manifest, purpose strings, keychain storage, App Transport Security and the SDK required for upload.

sources.title: Apple, requesting access to protected resources
Apple, upcoming requirements for App Store Connect

rules.instruction: Keep `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` in the app target with the collected data types, tracking domains and required reasons APIs the change adds. Check that each third-party SDK ships its own manifest.
rules.verification: Generate the privacy report from an archive in Xcode and compare it with the change and the App Store privacy answers.

rules.instruction: Add a purpose string in one complete sentence for each protected resource the change uses, localized for each supported locale.
rules.verification: Check the target's usage description keys in the Info.plist or build settings, and run the flow on a fresh install to see the prompt.

rules.instruction: Store tokens, passwords and keys in the keychain, not in UserDefaults, plist files or the app bundle.
rules.verification: Search the change for credentials written to UserDefaults or files, and test that sign-out removes the keychain items.

rules.instruction: Keep App Transport Security on. Add a domain-specific exception only for a named server that cannot use HTTPS with modern TLS, and never set `NSAllowsArbitraryLoads` in release builds.
rules.verification: Review the `NSAppTransportSecurity` dictionary of the release Info.plist and record the owner and end date of each exception.

rules.instruction: Build release archives with the Xcode and SDK versions App Store Connect requires, and keep the minimum deployment target above Apple's announced floor.
rules.verification: Compare the CI Xcode version and the deployment target with Apple's upcoming requirements page before the release.
